## dockerfile

Any Dockerfile - dependency scan, multi-arch image, scan, SBOM, signature (no language checks). Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/templates/build-workflows.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/templates/build-workflows.yaml).

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `repository` | object | yes |  | Git repository of the component (the platform GitHub App must be installed on it; each run gets a token for this repository only) |
| `repository.url` | string | yes |  | Git repository URL, under https://github.com/koorikla/ Pattern `^(https://github\.com/koorikla/)[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`. |
| `repository.revision` | object |  | `{}` |  |
| `repository.revision.branch` | string |  | `main` | Branch to build (and to commit the new image ref to) Pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$`. |
| `repository.revision.commit` | string |  | `""` | Commit to build (default: branch head) Pattern `^([0-9a-f]{7,40})?$`. |
| `repository.appPath` | string |  | `.` | Application directory within the repository Pattern `^(\.\|(\./)?\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*(/\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)*/?)$`. |
| `docker` | object |  | `{}` |  |
| `docker.context` | string |  | `.` | Build context, relative to the repository root Pattern `^(\.\|(\./)?\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*(/\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)*/?)$`. |
| `docker.filePath` | string |  | `Dockerfile` | Dockerfile, relative to the repository root Pattern `^(\.\|(\./)?\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*(/\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)*/?)$`. |
| `buildArgs` | object[] |  | `[]` | Dockerfile build arguments (VERSION=<short sha> is always set) |
| `buildArgs[].name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `buildArgs[].value` | string | yes |  |  |
| `platforms` | string |  | `linux/amd64,linux/arm64` | Image platforms (comma-separated). Foreign-arch RUN steps need QEMU binfmt on the build node; cross-compiling Dockerfiles do not. |
| `scan` | object |  | `{}` |  |
| `scan.failSeverities` | string |  | `CRITICAL` | Trivy severities that fail the build (lockfiles and image), before anything is signed |
| `scan.ignoreUnfixed` | boolean |  | `true` |  |
| `scan.ignoreFile` | string |  | `""` | Repository-relative .trivyignore.yaml with expiring, justified exceptions Pattern `^((\.\|(\./)?\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*(/\.?[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]*)*/?))?$`. |
| `gitops` | object |  | `{}` |  |
| `gitops.enabled` | boolean |  | `true` | Commit the signed image ref into the Workload manifest (Argo CD deploys it) |
| `gitops.workloadPath` | string |  | `deploy/openchoreo/workload.yaml` | OpenChoreo Workload manifest the signed image ref is committed to (only deploy/openchoreo/<name>.yaml) Pattern `^deploy/openchoreo/[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*\.yaml$`. |

## promotion-gate

Verifies a release in its source environment (pipeline path, readiness, HTTP smoke test, observer alerts, gateway 5xx rate, freeze windows) and opens the promotion pull request for the target environment's ReleaseBinding. Source: [addons/openchoreo-platform/templates/promotion-gate.yaml](../../addons/openchoreo-platform/templates/promotion-gate.yaml).

### parameters

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project` | string | yes |  | OpenChoreo project of the component Range 1..63 chars. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)?$`. |
| `component` | string | yes |  | Component to promote (its Workload's spec.source.repository is the repo the PR goes to) Range 1..63 chars. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)?$`. |
| `sourceEnvironment` | string |  | `staging` | Environment the release was verified in Range 1..63 chars. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)?$`. |
| `targetEnvironment` | string |  | `""` | Environment to promote to (empty = the next one in the project's DeploymentPipeline) Range ..63 chars. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?)?$`. |
| `release` | string |  | `""` | ComponentRelease to promote (empty = the one running in the source environment) Range ..253 chars. Pattern `^([a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9.]*[a-z0-9])?)?$`. |
| `dryRun` | boolean |  | `false` | Run every check but do not open the pull request |
